rationale: Record a web-compat focus change that crosses two families only through their broad core/view/** and test/** selectors. Script-side element.focus() now also requests native keyboard focus for the backing widget, and the autofocus attribute is honoured when an element mounts, through the web-compat element/event JS (core/view/js/web-compat-*.js), two widget-bridge functions (core/view/src/widget_bridge/dom_api.cpp, event_api.cpp) with their generated manifest and React typings, and the @pulp/react host config. test/web-compat/test_events_focus.cpp (pulp-test-web-compat-events) and packages/pulp-react/test/host-config-autofocus.test.ts cover the new behaviour; compat.json rows for focus and autofocus are updated. No importer, DesignIR, capture path, renderer, render asset, codegen output, visual fixture, threshold or Vellum-owned source changes, and no existing visual verdict changes. Registered as watch-only so the families' coverage stays honest about a change that crossed their selectors. No authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
